title: First Clinical Photon-counting Detector CT System: Technical Evaluation
lineage: Primary Mayo-led comparative technical and human imaging study, with disclosed Siemens research support.

passages.locator: Materials and Methods, First Clinical PCD CT system
passages.note: Confirms that Force and Alpha share the dual-source geometry and describes the Alpha's two photon-counting arrays. The paper's comparison is corroboration of architecture, not by itself documentary evidence of engineering transfer.
